description: Thunderbird's calendars for Voice Companion's Calendar screen: list calendars and events, add an event, delete an event. Times are milliseconds since 1970 (UTC); all-day dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

functions.name: listCalendars
functions.description: The calendars that are turned on. Resolves to [{id, name, type, readOnly}], or null when the calendar is not available.

functions.name: listEvents
functions.description: Events from startMs to endMs in every calendar that is turned on, repeating events expanded. Resolves to {events, failed}, or null.

functions.name: createEvent
functions.description: Add one event. Resolves to {created, id} or {created: false, reason}.

functions.name: deleteEvent
functions.description: Delete an event, or one day of a repeating event (occurrence) unless all is true. Resolves to {deleted, all} or {deleted: false, reason}.
